blocks.text: Anne Curtis and John Arcilla are set to lead the cast of director Mikhail Red’s upcoming paranoia thriller film “Remote,” which is scheduled to hit cinemas in 2027. Viva Films unveiled the first look at the cast on Tuesday, Oct. 6, featuring Curtis, Arcilla, Sid Lucero, Ryza Cenon and Zeke Polina. “The cameras are rolling for REMOTE. Anne Curtis John Arcilla Sid Lucero Ryza Cenon Zeke Polina from the look test. A film by Mikhail Red.
